report:
MRI of Left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


* Small focal signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus without significant extending into the surface, in favor of degeneration.
* A 11 mm ovoid lesion noted in the posterior compartment of left thigh; it show iso SI on T1WI imagings and heterogeneous high SI on T2WI imagings, in favor of schwannom, or other nerve sheath tumor
  It attaches the tibia nerve, femoral vessels and between the medial and lateral head of gastrocnemius muscle
* The 7 mm lesion noted in proximal tibia; it show iso SI on T1WI imagines, high SI on T2WI FS imagings, r/o osseous hemangioma or focal fatty depostion

> No significant bone marrow edema
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Preservation of quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.

Impression:
1. In favor of degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus
2. A 11 mm lesion noted in the posterior compartment of left thigh, in favor of schwannom, or other nerve sheath tumor
    It attaches the tibia nerve, femoral vessels and between the medial and lateral head of gastrocnemius muscle
3. The 7 mm lesion noted in proximal tibia, r/o osseous hemangioma or focal fatty depostion

Please correlate to clinical and laboratory manifestation

Left knee pain. 
MRI of left knee without contrast. 
Pulse sequences: sagittal T1, axial, coronal, sagittal T2 FS, sagittal PD FS

Findings: 
1. The ACL appears straight in contour but with some increased signal on T2W images. R/O Mild ACL sprain. 
The PCL appears intact. 
2. The medial & lateral menisci show no obvious tear. 
3. The medial & lateral collateral ligaments, quadriceps & patellar tendons show intact appearance. 
4. No obvious knee joint effusion. 
5. No bone marrow edema is seen. 
6. Intact patellar cartilage. 

IMP:
R/O Mild ACL sprain. 

Suggest clinical correlation.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sobrecarga compartimento lateral versus lesión meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la inserción distal del tendón
cuadricipital. Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Edema las partes blandas entre la banda de tibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
Signos un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de rótula y de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

FINDINGS:

There is no significant knee joint effusion or popliteal cyst.

The articular cartilage is preserved. There is normal bone marrow signal intensity.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

Unremarkable examination.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior horn düzeyinde evre 2 intra meniskal dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlenmiş olup medial menisküs laterale ekstrüdedir.Medial menisküs gövde-posterior horn düzeyinde kompleks yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm dikkati çekmektedir. Ayrıca medial menisküs posterior kesimde yırtık düzeyinde bütünlük kaybı yırtık lehinedir. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu kalınlaşma ve sinyal artımı izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Diz eklem aralığı ve suprapatellar bursada efüzyon mevcuttur.Diz eklem aralığı medial kompratmanda daha belirgin olmak üzere daralmış görünümde olup medial kompartmanda diz eklemi oluşturan kemik yapılarda kontüzyonel ödem dikkati çekti.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda yaygın dejeneratif sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Popliteal fossada yaklaşık 3 cm boyutunda baker kisti dikkati çekmiştir.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W



> Spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of knee and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage, more severe at femoral trochlea and patella, reflecting osteoarthritis of knee 
> Interstitial increased signal of ACL & PCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of chondromalacia.
> Linear signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
> Mild subcutaneous edema and muscle edema over left lower thigh to proximal leg.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee with grade 3-4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint.
2. Mild synovitis of left knee with medial and suprapatellar patellar plicae.
3. Degeneration of ACL and PCL.
4. Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
5. Subcutanoeus edema and muscle edema over left lower thigh to proximal leg.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

MRI Side  KNEE:

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable.

There is focal fissuring of the articular cartilage of the patella at the apex and particularly involving the medial facet. The finding is associated with subcortical interosseous edema and cyst formation within the patella. The articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea also demonstrates focal chondral fissuring at the trochlear apex with subcortical interosseous cyst formation also seen to the femoral trochlea.

No significant osteophytes are seen to the patellofemoral joint.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained overall.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is reasonably well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are intact and appear unremarkable.

There is no evidence of significant Baker's cyst or knee effusion.

INTERPRETATION: 

There is severe articular chondrosis of the patellofemoral joint associated with early evolving degenerative change in the patellofemoral joint compartment.

There is no evidence of internal derangement.

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. Myxoid degeneration of the body of medial meniscus is noted but no definite tear. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral articular cartilage. Mild fraying of the lateral patellar facet articular cartilage is noted. The patellofemoral articular cartilage is otherwise well maintained. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: Myxoid degeneration of the medial meniscal body but no definite tear.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones relevantes que consignar.
Rotura marginal del cuerno anterior y cuerpo del menisco lateral, sin desplazamiento de segmentos,
degenerativa.
Rotura compleja con componente horizontal oblicuo y radial incompleta del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del
menisco medial, sin desplazamiento de segmento. Esto se asocia a edema las partes blandas perimeniscal
es.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. El
resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor
parcial de la faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del tendón
rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Edema del tejido celular subcutánea la región anterior de la rodilla con laminar bursitis prepatelar.
Impresión:
Rotura marginal del menisco lateral.
Rotura compleja del menisco medial, sin desplazamiento de segmentos.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Edema del tejido celular subcutánea la región anterior de la rodilla con laminar bursitis prepatelar

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi.  Tibiofemoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, ödem ve dejeneratif milimetrik kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı. Medial menisküs diz ekleminden tamamı ile 6 mm mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküs hacminde azalma, menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve kompleks yırtıklar izlenmektedir. Lateral menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 5 mm laterale ekstrudedir.  Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlendi. Anterior hornda grade III dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Anterior çapraz bağın belirgin  olarak incelmiş olduğu ve sinyalinde PD imajlarda artış olduğu izlenmektedir. Arka çapraz bağ ve lateral kollateral ligamen normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamande periligamentöz ödem izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem lateralde periartiküler büyüğü 7 mm çaplı loose body formasyonları izlendi. Tibiofibular eklem aralığı daralmış, ekleme komşu tibia lateral plato ve fibula başında subkondrial kistler izlendi. Popliteal fossada 7x2 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi.Prepatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Sonuç: Gonartroz.Medial ve lateral meniskürde eklem mesafesinden ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı, grade III  dejenerasyon ve kompleks yırtıklar. Anterior çapraz bağda komplete yakın geniş yırtık. Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Suprapatellar bursit.  Diz ekleminde sinovit. Tibiofibular eklemde artroz.Tibiofemoral eklem anteriorunda periartiküler loose body formasyonları.  Popliteal fossada baker kisti.Patellada subkondrial kemik iliği ödemleri.
